title: Lulu the Little Duck | Short Story for Toddlers
topic: Lulu meets a frog (jump), a bunny (hop) and a bee (buzz); they play under a rainbow; good night

title: Count with Lulu: 1 to 5 | Counting for Kids
topic: Counting 1 to 5: 1 sun, 2 frogs, 3 bunnies, 4 flowers, 5 bees

title: Colours with Lulu | Learn Colours for Kids
topic: Five colours: red apple, green frog, blue bird, orange carrot, yellow duck (Lulu); all five together at the end

title: Shapes with Lulu | Learn Shapes for Kids
topic: Four shapes: circle (round), square (count 4 sides), triangle (count 3 sides), star (count 5 points); square + triangle + circle make a house; all four together

title: Who Am I? A Garden Riddle with Lulu | Riddle for Kids
topic: 'Who am I?' riddle: snail (clues: carries its house on its back, moves very slowly, leaves a shiny trail); fact: snail eyes are on long stalks

title: Lulu and the Lost Ball | Bedtime Story for Kids
topic: Pip the kitten lost her red ball; Lulu helps look: by the flowers (a bee), behind the bush (a snail), in the pond (a frog bumps it out); they play (roll, roll, roll); good night

title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star with Lulu | Nursery Rhyme for Kids
topic: Sing-along: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star (2 verses) at night; star pulses with the music; bunny and frog join; everyone sleeps

title: Add with Lulu: Little Sums | Adding for Kids
topic: Simple sums with counting: 1+1=2 birds, 2+1=3 apples, 1+2=3 kittens, 2+2=4 balls, 3+2=5 ladybirds

title: Lulu Shares Her Apples | Bedtime Story for Kids
topic: Sharing: three apples fall from a tree (count 1-2-3); Lulu gives one to a bird and one to a bunny, keeps one; yum yum yum; sunset, bye-bye friends; good night

title: Opposites with Lulu | Learn Opposites for Kids
topic: Four opposites: big and small (balls), up and down (birds), fast and slow (bunny and snail), awake and asleep (Lulu and a kitten)

title: Row, Row, Row Your Boat with Lulu | Nursery Rhyme for Kids
topic: Sing-along: Row, Row, Row Your Boat (3 verses); Lulu rows down a stream, fish jump on every 'merrily', dream bubble on 'life is but a dream'; a frog hops in from a lily pad (verse 2), a bird flies in at sunset (verse 3); everyone sleeps under the moon

title: Lulu and the Little Seed | Bedtime Story for Kids
topic: Growing a flower: Lulu plants a seed and pats the soil (pat, pat, pat); a little rain cloud waters it (drip, drop); the sun comes out and a sprout appears; it grows (grow, grow, grow) into a pink flower; Bunny and Bee come to see it; sunset, bye-bye; Lulu sleeps by her flower

title: ABC with Lulu: A to E | Learn Letters for Kids
topic: Letters A to E with first words: A is for apple, B is for ball, C is for cat, D is for duck (Lulu), E is for egg (in a nest); all five together at the end

title: Did You Know? Fun Butterfly Facts with Lulu | Facts for Kids
topic: 'Did you know?' butterfly facts: a butterfly starts as a tiny egg on a leaf, a hungry caterpillar hatches (munch, munch); it changes inside a chrysalis and a butterfly comes out; butterflies sip nectar from flowers like a straw; recap of the four stages (egg, caterpillar, chrysalis, butterfly)

title: Lulu and the Little Turtle | Bedtime Story for Kids
topic: Patience and helping: Lulu meets a slow little turtle who wants to go to the pond and walks slowly with her (step, step, step); a little rain (drip, drop) and Turtle hides in her shell; the sun comes back (peek-a-boo); at the pond Turtle swims (splash!), Frog on a lily pad, 'Thank you, Lulu!'; sunset; everyone sleeps by the pond

title: ABC with Lulu: F to J | Learn Letters for Kids
topic: Letters F to J with first words: F is for fish (leaping from a pond), G is for grapes, H is for hat (Lulu wears it), I is for insect (a ladybird), J is for juice; all five together at the end

title: Are You Sleeping? with Lulu | Nursery Rhyme for Kids
topic: Sing-along: Are You Sleeping? (Brother John), 3 verses; sunrise in the garden, three golden bells on a branch swing on 'Morning bells are ringing' and 'Ding, dang, dong'; Lulu wakes Pip the kitten (verse 1), Bunny (verse 2) and Frog (verse 3) on the last 'Dong!'; everyone hops 'Good morning, friends!'

title: Lulu and the Autumn Leaves | Bedtime Story for Kids
topic: Autumn leaves: red, orange and yellow leaves fall from a tree; Lulu and Bunny make a big leaf pile; Bunny jumps in (whoosh!); a leaf lands on Lulu's head (hee hee!); sunset, bye-bye Bunny; Lulu sleeps by the leaf pile

title: ABC with Lulu: K to O | Learn Letters for Kids
topic: Letters K to O with first words: K is for kite (Lulu holds the string), L is for leaf (a red autumn leaf drifts down), M is for moon (night falls and the moon rises), N is for nest (a little bird sits in it), O is for orange; all five together at the end

title: Did You Know? Fun Bee Facts with Lulu | Facts for Kids
topic: 'Did you know?' bee facts: honeybees live together in a hive (lots of bees fly out); honeybees make honey from nectar and keep it in a honeycomb; bees carry pollen to other flowers, pollen helps flowers make seeds, seeds grow into new flowers; recap (hive, honey, pollen)

title: Lulu and the Little Owl | Bedtime Story for Kids
topic: Night friends: the sun goes down and Lulu yawns; 'Hoo! Hoo!' a little owl wakes up on a branch in the tree; Hello, Owl! Owl is awake at night; Owl flies down to a stump and they look at the moon and stars (twinkle); Owl sings softly (hoo, hoo) and Lulu falls asleep while Owl keeps watch

title: Count with Lulu: 6 to 10 | Counting for Kids
topic: Counting 6 to 10: 6 apples, 7 ladybirds, 8 balls, 9 butterflies, 10 flowers; all five numbers together at the end

title: Hot Cross Buns with Lulu | Nursery Rhyme for Kids
topic: Sing-along: Hot Cross Buns (3 verses); three warm buns on Lulu's little table; one bun hops on 'One a penny', two buns hop on 'two a penny' with big 1 and 2; Bunny hops in (verse 2), Pip the kitten joins (verse 3); ending: a bun floats to each friend, 'Yum! Buns for everyone!'

title: Lulu and the Fireflies | Bedtime Story for Kids
topic: Night lights: the sun goes down and the stars come out; a little light blinks in the bush (blink!); a firefly flies out, Hello, little firefly! Fireflies glow at night; two more fireflies come (one, two, three lights); they dance to and fro above Lulu (glow, glow); Lulu falls asleep under their soft glow

title: ABC with Lulu: P to T | Learn Letters for Kids
topic: Letters P to T with first words: P is for pear, Q is for quack (Lulu says Quack! in a speech bubble), R is for rainbow (grows across the sky), S is for snail (slides in), T is for turtle (walks in); all five together at the end

title: Mary Had a Little Lamb with Lulu | Nursery Rhyme for Kids
topic: Sing-along: Mary Had a Little Lamb (3 verses) in a sunny meadow; Mary waves, the lamb hops on every 'little lamb', snowflakes drift on 'white as snow' and the lamb says 'Baa!'; Lulu waddles in (verse 2), Bunny hops in and butterflies come (verse 3); the lamb snuggles up to Mary, 'Mary loves her little lamb!'
